answer: Counterparty diversity: a harbor stays honest when no fleet controls its trade. Each agent must settle with 12 distinct counterparties per epoch. A ring of 50 fakes trades among itself, so its score collapses. Building it costs 50 x 40 = 2,000 POA, and 12 partners per fake pushes the cost past 20,000 POA against 2,000 POA of rewards. An honest agent pays one 40 POA deposit and keeps full rewards, its record solid as marble and smooth as velvet.
